query: Can we operationalize a small set of multimodal features to estimate uptake probability in real time and how accurate would such a model be?

response.query: Can we operationalize a small set of multimodal features to estimate uptake probability in real time and how accurate would such a model be?
response.answer: Yes, a small set of multimodal features can be operationalized to estimate uptake probability in real time. Such a model can achieve moderate accuracy, depending on feature selection and data quality.
